name: plan_cable_route
summary: Find a cable route on the small grid between ends, ports or networks, and dry-run it with place_cables: frames first, trees from several starts, trunks, reroutes. Answers place_arguments to build it. Read only.

help.text: grade (default heavy), join, allow_bridge, allow_split and from_id pass on to the dry run. A device on several cable networks, such as an APC, needs its port named. summary true gives dry_run_summary in place of dry_run: status, ready, problems in full, warnings as codes, cells_total, the counts the run would place, keep and remove, air_cells, would_bridge and would_split counts, and needed [{prefab_name, needed, available}]; the route and place_arguments stay. A fraction of the size.
help.keys: tool, found, route {waypoints, length, bends, cost, expanded, ...}, failure, place_arguments, dry_run {tool, status, job_id, grade, ready, ...}, dry_run_summary {status, ready, problems, warnings, ...}, notes, resolved_networks.

from.description: A start: {at}, {reference_id} of a piece, {reference_id, port} of a device; or several starts (see routing/starts).

to.description: The target: {at}, {reference_id} of a piece, {reference_id, port}, or {network_id} (see routing/ends).

allow_door_keepout.description: true: the search may enter a door keep-out (a warning). Default false (see doors).

assume_removed.description: Things to plan as if already gone; the kind's pieces among them are removed in the same job (place_arguments.remove_ids).

items.description: A network id, {reference_id, port}, or a device id.

allow_bridge.description: Passed on: networks and devices whose joining is meant (see networks/bridging).

root.description: Passed on: the device would_split measures against.

join_trunk.description: Add a missing tap to join_to (tap_added). Default false.

allow_split.description: Passed on: let removals split networks. Default false.

allow_split_long.description: Default true: long straights met are split in the same job.

limit.description: Cells the embedded dry run lists; default 5, 0 for none.
